```lean
import Algebra.Lie.Algebra
import Algebra.Lie.Killing
import Algebra.Module.Finite
import Algebra.Lie.Derivations

open LieAlgebra

theorem lg_target (R : Type u_1) (L : Type u_2) [Field R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] [Module.Finite R L] [LieAlgebra.IsKilling R L] : LieAlgebra.IsKilling R ↥(LieDerivation.ad R L).range := by
  let ad : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L := LieDerivation.ad R L
  let range_ad := ad.range

  -- The adjoint map is a Lie algebra homomorphism
  have h_ad_hom : IsLieAlgebraHom R ad := by
    refine IsLieAlgebraHom.mk _ _
    · exact ad
    · intros x y
      rw [LieBracket.def, LieBracket.def]
      simp only [LieDerivation.ad_apply, LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      erw [LieBracket.def, LieBracket.def]
      simp only [LieDerivation.ad_apply]

  -- The range of the adjoint map is a Lie subalgebra
  have h_range_subalgebra : IsLieSubalgebra R range_ad := by
    refine IsLieSubalgebra.mk _ _ _ _
    · exact range_ad
    · intros x y
      rw [LieBracket.def, LieBracket.def]
      simp only [LieDerivation.ad_apply, LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      erw [LieBracket.def, LieBracket.def]
      simp only [LieDerivation.ad_apply]
    · intros x r
      rw [LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      erw [LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      simp only [smul_eq_zero, smul_add, add_smul]
    · intro x
      rw [LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      erw [LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      simp only [zero_smul]

  -- The range of the adjoint map is a Lie submodule
  have h_range_submodule : IsLieSubmodule R range_ad := by
    refine IsLieSubmodule.mk _ _ _
    · exact range_ad
    · intros x r
      rw [LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      erw [LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      simp only [smul_eq_zero, smul_add, add_smul]
    · intro x
      rw [LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      erw [LieDerivation.ad_apply]
      simp only [zero_smul]

  -- The Killing form restricted to the range is non-degenerate
  have h_killing_range : LieAlgebra.IsKilling R range_ad := by
    refine LieAlgebra.IsKilling.of_equiv _ _
    · exact LieAlgebra.Equiv.of_bijective ad (by simp)
    · exact LieAlgebra.IsKilling.killingForm_nondegenerate R L

  exact h_killing_range
```
